description: Cross-Run Analytics components — CrossRunPatternsPanel and StepProvenanceTimeline. These are used within the Reflection Dashboard and can be composed into other views. CrossRunPatternsPanel shows recurring_finding and fix_oscillation patterns detected across workflow runs via the knowledge graph's cross_run_patterns table. StepProvenanceTimeline shows which pipeline agent (discovery, builder, fixer, hardener, verifier) generated each workflow step, with UI Bridge interaction counts overlaid from step_provenance.ui_bridge_event_ids. Also covers SelectorDecayChart (element success rate over time windows) and FailureChainViewer (graph traversal from UI element through task_run to workflow/finding).

groups.name: Cross-Run Pattern Detection
groups.description: Shows patterns detected across multiple workflow runs. Two pattern types: recurring_finding (same error appears in >= 3 runs, yellow badge with TrendingUp icon) and fix_oscillation (a fix resolves an issue but it recurs, orange badge with RefreshCw icon). Each pattern shows signature_hash (first 12 chars, monospace), occurrence count (bold Nx), last seen date, status badge (active=red, resolved=green, suppressed=muted), and affected components. Backed by GET /graph/cross-run-patterns.

assertions.description: The cross-run patterns panel is identifiable
Pattern types are visually distinguished: recurring findings show yellow TrendingUp badges, fix oscillations show orange RefreshCw badges

target.label: Pattern type badge indicating recurring or oscillation

assertions.description: Pattern status badges communicate urgency: active (red) means the pattern is still occurring, resolved (green) means a fix worked, suppressed (gray) means intentionally ignored
When no patterns exist, the user is reassured

groups.name: Step Provenance Timeline
groups.description: Vertical timeline showing workflow step generation history. Each step has a colored dot (blue=discovery, green=builder, orange=fixer, purple=hardener, cyan=verifier), step name, phase badge (setup/verification/agentic/completion), step index, generating agent name (monospace), generation iteration, and UI Bridge interaction count (parsed from ui_bridge_event_ids JSON array). Legend at bottom shows agent color mapping. Max height 384px with scroll. Backed by GET /graph/step-provenance?workflow_id=X.

assertions.description: The step provenance timeline is identifiable
The legend shows color coding for pipeline agents: discovery (blue), builder (green), fixer (orange), hardener (purple), verifier (cyan)
Steps that involved UI Bridge interactions show a count badge (e.g., '3 UI interactions') indicating how many element actions occurred during that step's execution

target.label: UI interaction count on provenance steps

groups.name: Selector Decay Curve
groups.description: Line chart showing a single element's success rate over time windows. Used for element detail views, not the main dashboard. X-axis shows window labels (W1, W2, ...), Y-axis shows 0-100% with a dashed reference line at 95% (reliability threshold). Uses Recharts LineChart with primary color, stroke width 2, dots enabled. A declining curve indicates selector degradation requiring CTR updates. Backed by GET /ui-bridge/analytics/decay-curve?element_id=X&window_ms=86400000&windows=7.

assertions.description: The decay chart shows the element ID in monospace after 'Selector Decay:'

target.label: Decay chart heading with TrendingDown icon and element ID

assertions.description: The chart includes a dashed reference line at 95% marking the reliability threshold — elements below this line are considered unreliable

groups.name: Failure Chain Viewer
groups.description: Graph traversal visualization showing the causal chain behind a UI element's failures. Traverses the knowledge graph: UIElement ← InteractedWith ← TaskRun → BelongsTo → Workflow, collecting connected findings and fixes. Each node in the chain has a colored dot (ui_element=blue, task_run=purple, workflow=green, finding=orange, fix=cyan, rule=yellow, error=red), kind label, and entity name (monospace). Nodes are connected by ChevronRight arrows with edge kind labels. Legend at bottom shows node type colors. Backed by GET /graph/ui-failure-chain?element_id=X.

assertions.description: The failure chain viewer shows the element ID being traced

target.label: Failure chain heading with GitMerge icon and element ID

assertions.description: The legend shows all knowledge graph node types with color coding: ui_element, task_run, workflow, finding, fix, rule, error

target.label: Node type legend in failure chain

assertions.description: When no causal chain is found, the user is informed

target.label: Empty state when no chains exist
